steps.message: Is the note titled 'Budget Spreadsheet' in the Joplin app marked as a todo item? Respond with either 'True' if it is a todo or 'False' if not.

Execute: adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i joplin; ls -d /data/data/*joplin* 2>/dev/null; ls -d /data/user/0/*joplin* 2>/dev/null; find /data/data -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -name '*.sqlite' -o -name '*.db' \) 2>/dev/null | grep -i joplin; find /data/user/0 -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -name '*.sqlite' -o -name '*.db' \) 2>/dev/null | grep -i joplin"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i joplin; ls -d /data/data/*joplin* 2>/dev/null; ls -d /data/user/0/*joplin* 2>/dev/null; find /data/data -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -name '*.sqlite' -o -name '*.db' \) 2>/dev/null | grep -i joplin; find /data/user/0 -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -name '*.sqlite' -o -name '*.db' \) 2>/dev/null | grep -i joplin""
